title: Databricks buys Row Zero and is scouting for more startups to acquire | TechCrunch
summary: The story goes that Databricks’ finance team fell in love with Row Zero because it was a cloud tool that could scale beyond 1 million live spreadsheet rows. They were combining Row Zero with Databricks’ homegrown AI agent called Genie.
